people.name: Ammon
people.line: An ancient nation and its capital city, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Amorites
people.line: Canaanite people group, enemies of Israel

people.name: Arnon
people.line: A river and valley, serving as a boundary for Israel.

people.name: Aroer
people.line: A city on the edge of the Arnon Valley.

people.name: Gilead
people.line: Mountainous region east of Jordan; tribal territory and personal name.

people.name: Heshbon
people.line: Amorite city conquered by Moses, allotted to Reuben

people.name: Jabbok
people.line: A river east of the Jordan, associated with Jacob

people.name: Sihon
people.line: Amorite king of Heshbon, defeated by the Israelites.

translations.web: Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon, and ruled from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the middle of the valley, and half Gilead, even to the river Jabbok, the border of the children of Ammon;
translations.bsb: Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon. He ruled from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Valley, along the middle of the valley, up to the Jabbok River (the border of the Ammonites), that is, half of Gilead,
translations.kjv: Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon, and ruled from Aroer, which is upon the bank of the river Arnon, and from the middle of the river, and from half Gilead, even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;
translations.asv: Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon, and ruled from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and half Gilead, even unto the river Jabbok, the border of the children of Ammon;
